hook_text: How many crates fit in this truck? Counting them one by one takes forever. Layers take seconds.
clip_script: Fruit packhouse in Ceres! A box 5 by 4 by 3. Fill the bottom: 4 rows of 5, that is 20 cubes. Stack another layer, and another. 3 layers: 60 cubes! Length times width times height. Now the truck: 6 crates long, 4 wide. 24 in a layer. 3 layers high: 72 crates! Not 13, that is adding. Not 24, that is one layer. Layer by layer!
visual_style: Small cubes snapping into a clear box layer by layer, then crates stacking in a truck with a glowing count.
mood: Busy and satisfying, like a packing line.
pacing: Quick layer builds, a pause on wrong answers, then the full truck reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find the volume of a cereal box at home.
